title: Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary Education Amendment Act 2005

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary Education Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2005
ACT II OF 2005
Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary
Education (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to amend the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV-A, 6th
July, 2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education
(Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary Education Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972

ACT II OF 2005
ACT II OF 2005
Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary
Education (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to amend the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV-A, 6th
July, 2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.--In the Sindh Boards and Intermediate and Secondary
Education Ordinance, 1972,
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, in clause (u), for the words `Board at
Hyderabad', the words "Boards at Hyderabad and
Mirpurkhas" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary Education Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972

ACT II OF 2005
ACT II OF 2005
Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary
Education (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to amend the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV-A, 6th
July, 2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:‑
3. Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.--In the said Ordinance , in section 3, in subsection
(1),-‑
(i)
in clause (c) the word "and" occurring at the end shall be
deleted;
(ii)
in clause (d), for the full stop occurring at the end, the semi colon and the
word "are" shall be substituted and thereafter the
following shall be added:-‑
"(e) at Mirpurkhas,
a Board called the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education,
Mirpurkhas."

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary Education Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972

ACT II OF 2005
ACT II OF 2005
Sindh Boards Of Intermediate And Secondary
Education (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to amend the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV-A, 6th
July, 2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:‑
4. Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.--In the said Ordinance, in section 4, in subsection
(1), in clause (iii)--
(i)
in sub-clause (d), the word "and" occurring at the end
shall be deleted;
(ii)
in sub-clause (e), for the full stop occurring at the end, a semi colon and the
word "and" shall be substituted and thereafter the following shall be
added:-‑
"(f)
the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Mirpurkhas, the Executive
District Officer Education."

ACT II OF 2005

An Act to amend the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972

5. Amendment of Schedule to Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.--In the said Ordinance, in the Schedule, for the
